phase.name: Phase D kickoff
phase.goal: Advance from milestone-C hardening into production-readiness controls, validation depth, and operational rollout discipline.

entry_criteria: Milestone-C live-trading gap closure branch is pushed and has an open PR.
Full baseline quality checks pass on current implementation.

priority_work_items.title: Finalize and merge QA policy updates
priority_work_items.problem_statement: Carry-over QA/CI hardening edits are present locally and need formal review/merge flow.
scope: Review and stage CI, README, CONTRIBUTING, WARP, and skills QA updates.
Run CI-equivalent local checks for lint, security, UX, and typing.
Open dedicated PR if not bundled with current stream.
acceptance_criteria: CI pipeline definition reflects agreed QA gates.
Contributor and project docs are aligned with executable commands.
QA skill artifact is versioned and discoverable in skills index.
validation_commands: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m unittest tests.test_integration_adapters tests.test_llm_policy tests.test_parameter_governance
PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m unittest tests.test_runtime_web_gui tests.test_runtime_supervisor_controls tests.test_runtime_supervisor_live

priority_work_items.title: Operationalize live credential lifecycle
priority_work_items.problem_statement: Secret provenance checks exist in code but operational credential sourcing/rotation workflow needs enforced runbook integration.
scope: Define non-interactive credential sourcing procedure for runtime and supervisor runs.
Add explicit preflight checks for required secret source and rotation metadata.
Document rotation SLO and alerting hook strategy.
acceptance_criteria: Runtime startup fails fast on credential provenance or stale rotation state.
Operator runbook includes secure sourcing and rotation verification steps.
Regression tests cover stale/missing provenance edge cases.

priority_work_items.title: Expand live-mode rehearsal and rollback protocol
priority_work_items.problem_statement: Live ingestion and control actions are wired, but phase-to-phase rollout and rollback discipline require explicit rehearsal artifacts.
scope: Add phased rehearsal scenarios for kill-switch and cancel-all recovery drills.
Add pre-check/post-check command bundle for rollout windows.
Define rollback decision matrix for operator actions and reconciliation anomalies.
acceptance_criteria: Rehearsal outputs include deterministic evidence for control actions.
Rollback trigger conditions are explicit and testable.
Runbook and scripts remain reproducible from clean environment.

handoff_notes: Preserve current carry-over edits while starting next phase; do not reset them automatically.
Use short-lived feature branches under feat/poly-robot-* naming for each D-phase workstream.
